title: Client Reception & Business Dinner（客户接待与宴请）

lines.text: Hi, great to finally meet you in person. Thanks for the warm welcome.
lines.translation: 你好，终于见面了。感谢你们的热情欢迎。

lines.text: Long, but smooth. I managed to sleep most of the way.
lines.translation: 飞了很久，但很顺利。路上大部分时间我都在睡。

lines.text: That's very kind. The city looks even more impressive than last time.
lines.translation: 太贴心了。这座城市比上次来更让人印象深刻了。

lines.text: I'd like that. I've heard a lot about your new showroom.
lines.translation: 好啊，久闻你们新展厅的大名了。

lines.text: Sounds great. I'm curious to try real Peking duck.
lines.translation: 太好了。我一直想尝尝正宗的北京烤鸭。

lines.text: Thank you. Here's to a successful partnership!
lines.translation: 谢谢。为我们成功的合作干杯！

lines.text: I appreciate the hospitality. This has been a lovely evening.
lines.translation: 感谢你们的盛情款待，今晚非常愉快。

lines.text: Welcome to Beijing! How was your flight?
lines.translation: 欢迎来到北京！旅途还顺利吗？

lines.text: Glad to hear it. We've arranged a car to take you to the hotel.
lines.translation: 那就好。我们已经安排了车送您去酒店。

lines.text: It changes fast. Tomorrow we'd love to show you the new showroom first.
lines.translation: 这里变化很快。明天我们想先带您参观一下新展厅。

lines.text: Now, shall we head to dinner? We've booked a private room nearby.
lines.translation: 那我们出发去吃晚饭好吗？已经在附近订好了包间。

lines.text: You're in for a treat — it's the restaurant's specialty. Please, after you.
lines.translation: 您有口福了——烤鸭正是这家店的招牌。您先请。

lines.text: Cheers! To our partnership, and to many more visits.
lines.translation: 干杯！愿我们合作长久，常来常往。

lines.text: The pleasure is ours. Get some rest — tomorrow will be a full day.
lines.translation: 这是我们的荣幸。好好休息——明天行程很满。
